title: WorkCommandCatalog
description: Generation catalog for the isolated JD work-command probe. Each tool receives its named object definition, never this catalog.

text.description: The complete outcome or execution requirement, supported by the interview.

basis_refs.description: Issued source references supporting only this item; empty when none are available.

capability_ref.description: Issued reference to existing knowledge or skill in this JD.

basis_refs.description: Issued sources supporting this task-to-capability relation.

CreateTaskInput.title: CreateTaskInput
CreateTaskInput.description: Create one identifiable task with all currently known outcomes, requirements and existing capability relations as one business effect. The App allocates identities and validates the final task before saving.

container_ref.description: Issued duty or unassigned-task container reference.

after_ref.description: Issued existing sibling reference; null places the task first.

name.description: Known task name. At least name or description must contain meaningful content.

description.description: Complete known task description and necessary task-specific scope; unknown content is not invented.

basis_refs.description: Issued sources for the task itself, not automatically for its children or capability relations.

target_field_ref.description: Issued reference to one existing full-text field, never a selection or arbitrary JSON path.

text.description: The complete replacement field value. Null is allowed only when the final domain item permits it.

after_ref.description: Issued surviving sibling of the same detail kind; null means first.

detail_ref.description: Issued reference to an existing outcome or requirement.

basis_refs.description: Issued sources for linking. Must be empty when unlinking; the shared domain validates this condition.

container_ref.description: Issued sixth-section container for an existing condition kind.

ReviseWorkInput.title: ReviseWorkInput
ReviseWorkInput.description: Apply one complete correction using only the six named changes, all against the same current view. The shared domain rejects the whole correction on any invalid target, conflicting change or limit failure; it does not save partial changes.

changes.description: At least one change. The App validates configured limits, final content, references and relations before saving.

SetTextInput.title: SetTextInput
SetTextInput.description: Replace one existing field with its complete text. This does not accept a selection reference. Related multi-field corrections use revise_work; the domain validates meaningful final content.

target_field_ref.description: Issued reference to an existing full-text field, never an item, selection or JSON path.

text.description: Complete replacement value. Null is accepted only if the target field and final item allow it; clearing a field does not delete the item.

basis_refs.description: Issued sources checked against the resulting content. Empty preserves existing links and their previous basis.

after_ref.description: Issued existing sibling or null for first.

scope_text.description: Known duty summary. Necessary task-specific limits remain on the tasks; no implicit condition inheritance.

after_ref.description: Issued existing sibling or null for first.

scope_text.description: Known cooperation scope; unknown organizational roles are not invented.

after_ref.description: Issued existing sibling or null for first.

description.description: Known concepts, principles or rules needed for the work, including their use and scope. Names need not be unique.

after_ref.description: Issued existing sibling or null for first.

description.description: Known methods applied to perform the work and their scope, not an employee score or training plan.

container_ref.description: Issued outcome-list container of an existing task.

after_ref.description: Issued existing outcome sibling or null for first.

text.description: Known deliverable, service result or maintained state and its receiver where relevant. No requirement pairing is implied.

container_ref.description: Issued requirement-list container of an existing task.

after_ref.description: Issued existing requirement sibling or null for first.

text.description: Known execution, quality, safety, timing or exception requirement, with its applicable condition. Kept separate from task description and outcomes.

container_ref.description: Issued sixth-section container identifying the existing condition kind. Only position-wide conditions belong here.

after_ref.description: Issued existing sibling in that condition kind or null for first.

text.description: Known whole-position condition or boundary. Task-specific scope stays on the task; unknown does not mean no requirement.

InsertItemInput.title: InsertItemInput
InsertItemInput.description: Create one duty, collaborator, shared knowledge or skill, task outcome or requirement, or position-wide condition with its currently known content. Create complete tasks with create_task, never as item shells. The domain validates each final item and allocates its identity.

DeleteItemInput.title: DeleteItemInput
DeleteItemInput.description: Delete one existing item with its defined ownership effects. Deleting a duty retains its tasks unassigned, including necessary scope; deleting linked shared knowledge or skill is rejected. Only duty deletion may include the two bounded content adjustments for its surviving tasks, validated together by the domain.

target_ref.description: Issued reference to the existing item; not a field or selection.

content_changes.description: Empty for ordinary deletion. Duty deletion may adjust related surviving task fields or add outcomes/requirements so necessary scope is not lost. No unrelated changes or references to newly created items.

MoveItemInput.title: MoveItemInput
MoveItemInput.description: Move a task between duties or the unassigned list, or reorder an existing item. Preserve identity, owned content, capability relations and sources. Grouping does not inherit destination conditions. The domain validates permitted related scope adjustments and the structural change as one complete candidate.

target_ref.description: Issued reference to the existing item, never a newly allocated or reconstructed item.

destination_container_ref.description: Issued compatible destination container. The App resolves ownership and condition kind.

after_ref.description: Issued existing sibling in the destination container; null means first.

content_changes.description: Empty for ordinary reorder. Task regrouping may adjust its fields, add its outcomes/requirements, or update source/destination duty summaries. Only the related targets allowed by the domain may change.

SetTaskCapabilityInput.title: SetTaskCapabilityInput
SetTaskCapabilityInput.description: Link or unlink one task and existing shared knowledge or skill using issued references. Names are not identities. Unlinking does not delete the shared definition or change other tasks; reverse uses come from the same relation.

capability_ref.description: Issued reference to existing knowledge or skill in this JD, not a name or copied definition.

basis_refs.description: Issued sources for linking. Must be empty for unlink; the shared domain validates that condition.

ReplaceSelectionInput.title: ReplaceSelectionInput
ReplaceSelectionInput.description: Replace exactly the text identified by an App-issued selection in one saved field. This input is replacement text only, never the whole field. The App owns the base, field, exact range and Unicode offset validation; stale or mismatched selections are rejected without searching for matching text.

selection_ref.description: Issued selection reference only. Do not provide a field reference, old text, line numbers or offsets.

replacement_text.description: Replacement for only the selected span, including any intended line breaks. Empty string removes the span; the domain validates the resulting field and item.

basis_refs.description: Sources checked against the complete resulting source target. Leave empty when only the selected fragment was checked; do not promote fragment support to whole-target support.

RestoreRevisionInput.title: RestoreRevisionInput
RestoreRevisionInput.description: Manual whole-document restore. Never offered to the model: taking a document back is the employee's decision.

target_revision_id.description: A saved revision of this same document whose complete content becomes the new current JD.

UndoAiTurnInput.title: UndoAiTurnInput
UndoAiTurnInput.description: Manual undo of one AI turn's JD changes. Never offered to the model, and never carries where to go back to: the server derives that from the turn's own committed operations.

ai_run_id.description: The AI turn whose JD changes should be taken back.

expected_result_revision_id.description: The revision the App showed as that turn's end; a different current head refuses the undo.
